summary: The patch introduces a check to prevent overriding get_FOO_display() methods, which may not be the intended behavior.

issues.description: The patch introduces a behavioral change that prevents overriding get_FOO_display() methods, which may break existing code that relies on this functionality.
There are no tests provided to verify the behavior of the patch in different scenarios, such as when the method already exists or when there are multiple fields with the same name.
